question: In June 2020, a review was published by two authors in Clinical reviews in allergy & immunology regarding the relationship between hypermobile Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome (hEDS), Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome (POTS), and Mast Cell Activation Syndrome (MCAS). Using PubMed, go to the 2nd publication (published in 2008) that this review references, and identify the geneticist who published the classification of one of the previous syndromes in 1998. What is the title of this geneticist’s first publication in The Practitioner?
gold_answer: Amitriptyline poisoning treated by forced diuresis.
